error[MBS-E12]: this `discard` isn't an alpha test
  --> e12_discard.mbs:34:3
   |
34 |         discard()
   |         ^^^^^^^^^ not an alpha test
   |
   = note: on the 3DS `discard` is the hardware alpha test: one comparison of the returned colour's alpha with one reference, as the last statement before `return`
   = help: write `if color.a < reference { discard() }` straight before `return color`, with a number or an `f32` uniform as the reference
   = more: docs/shader_errors.md#mbs-e12

mbsc: e12_discard.mbs: 1 error(s)
